mentions.name: digs.fm
mentions.description: This app is like Goodreads but for music: it lets users organize albums they want to listen to, have listened to, and liked, discover new music, see what other users they trust are discovering, and join Listening Groups. It has recently seen considerable UX improvements and a new Listening Groups feature.
mentions.problem: The author needed a better way to organize albums they want to listen to, have listened to, and liked while being deliberate about discovering new music.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://digs.fm - like Goodreads, but for music.

As someone who's constantly on the look for new music to discover and being very deliberate about the things I'm listening, I needed a better way to organize the albums I want to listen to, listened and liked. And also I would like to see the discoveries of other folks who I know I like.

Recently I improved the UX considerably and also added a Listening Groups feature.
